description: Who receives each notification, and the accounts kept off role-wide notifications.

fields.description: Tick the groups that receive each notification. Untick a group to stop sending it to them. Notifications where someone has to act (MR approved, pass back at the gate) still reach the Team when nobody else ticked holds a team role.
fields.label: Who Gets Each Notification

fields.description: Shared admin and IT accounts. They stop getting every notification sent to everyone holding a role, approval requests for their roles included, but still get anything that names them: documents they raised and approval steps assigned to them by name. Their approval rights do not change. In My Pending Actions their role-wide items move to "Open to my roles".
fields.label: Skip List

fields.description: People told about a cost centre's events without approving anything (the "CC Notify" tick). Edited on the Assign People page. Kept here, not on the approval config, so adding someone gives them no cost-centre restriction.
fields.label: Notify-only People
